<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$pages = array('home'=>'Demo Home','services'=>'Demo Services','about'=>'Demo About','areas'=>'Demo Areas','contact'=>'Demo Contact');
foreach ($pages as $slug=>$name) {
 $found=get_page_by_path($slug);
 if (!$found) { $id=wp_insert_post(array('post_title'=>$name,'post_name'=>$slug,'post_type'=>'page','post_status'=>'publish','post_content'=>'Fictional WordPress capability demo. No customer services or booking requests accepted.')); }
 else { $id=$found->ID; }
 if ($slug==='home' && is_numeric($id)) { update_option('show_on_front','page');update_option('page_on_front',(int)$id); }
}
